meta.title: Detector M-C — Hero #2 Hydration + perf infra
notes: Pure extension logic — fully unit-testable here, no new deps (unlike S1). Best autonomous-ralph fit.

Detector DoD applies: positive+negative fixtures under test/fixtures/, emit-on-positive + zero-on-negative test, vitest-bench baseline, CHANGELOG entry, IssueType enum addition (additive), Settings entry.

M-C.3 source-map uses chrome.debugger / DevTools — the lookup RUN is a humanGate (needs the debugger permission + a real page); the cache + module structure + the static 'no detector imports' rule are verifiable here.
Enum: IssueType currently has no HYDRATION_MISMATCH — added additively (contract-safe).
humanGates: M-C.3: exercising chrome.debugger Debugger.getScriptSource against a real page (needs the 'debugger' permission prompt + DevTools) — task 3.3.3 execution.

stories.title: M-C.1 — cache tryInferStateName (WeakMap)
acceptanceCriteria: A WeakMap<Function,string[]> cache backs state-name inference so the per-commit toString()+regex runs at most once per component function; a cache-hit path returns the memoized names.
A unit test proves: same function → second lookup is served from cache (toString spy called once) and returns identical names; distinct functions cache independently.
npm run typecheck exits 0 (verified with `npx tsc --noEmit`, not through a pipe).

stories.title: M-C.2 — fair-share per-detector deadline allocator + yield/resume
acceptanceCriteria: A pure allocator computes each detector's onCommit deadline = start + detector.budgetMs and supports yield-and-resume: a detector that returns an incomplete cursor is resumed next commit from that cursor.
Unit tests assert: deadline math; a detector over budget yields a cursor that is persisted via ctx.write and read back next commit; a fresh detector starts from no cursor.
A vitest-bench case shows allocator overhead < 0.1ms/commit (recorded to bench/baselines).

stories.title: M-C.3 — source-map lookup helper (cache + boundary; run is humanGate)
acceptanceCriteria: src/devtools/source-map-lookup.ts exports lookupSourcePosition({scriptId,line,column}) with an in-session cache keyed by (scriptId,line,column).
A unit test proves the cache: a repeated lookup with the same key does not re-invoke the injected resolver.
Static-analysis test: zero imports of source-map-lookup from src/inject/detectors/ (grep/AST assertion).
npm run typecheck exits 0. NOTE: the real chrome.debugger getScriptSource RESOLUTION is a humanGate.

stories.title: M-C.4 — Hero hydration-mismatch detector
acceptanceCriteria: src/inject/detectors/hydration-mismatch.ts conforms to the Detector interface and detects hydration failures (console.error 'Hydration failed'/'did not match' interception + fiber walk to the mismatching component).
Emits Issue{ type:'HYDRATION_MISMATCH', component, prop?, server?, client? } — 'HYDRATION_MISMATCH' added additively to the IssueType enum.
test/fixtures/hydration-mismatch/ has a positive fixture (intentional mismatch) + negative; a registry-harness test asserts one HYDRATION_MISMATCH on positive and zero on negative.
vitest-bench baseline recorded; CHANGELOG [Unreleased] additive entry; Settings UI entry (confidence declared). npm run typecheck exits 0 and the detector suite passes.
